title: bjvm website
body:
attempting to set this up to be hosted on GH pages; tried my best to reduce the duplication in dist

still think it might be better to put this in a separate repo but this is a working proof of concept

```sh
cd js/pages
npm run setup
npm i
npm run preview
```

I gitignored the jar/classfiles in `public` to avoid duplication, so to use hot reload:

```sh
cd public/assets
javac Conway2D.java && jar cvf Conway2D.jar Conway2D.class GameOfLife.class && java Conway2D
npm run dev
```
author: laura-a-n-n

comments.body: This pull request implements #82 and #21, as well as making actions like `Thread.sleep` and `Object.wait` interruptible
Also properly rigorously scheduled and tested (#93), so it's no longer just a glorified spin-wait
